payload.title: The web Forecast tab can only show an informational SITE row: the authoritative tenant pool is unreachable, so it shows 'runs out in 0 d / Action required' for feed the pool covers for 68 days while mobile says OK
payload.rule_violated: A surface shows the scope the backend decides on, and two surfaces do not contradict each other on the same snapshot
payload.notes: Found by the 2026-10-26 Feeding production E2E audit (report: docs/reviews/claude/2026-10-27-feeding-audit-report.md).
narrative: Same instant, same snapshot: web (site GUI3 Kara RAS) 'GUI3-FD-1 runs out in 0d'; protocolFeedForecast(siteId: null) FD-1 368.8 kg no stockout; mobile warehouseSummary.feedCoverage FD-2 68 days OK. Fix: a 'Whole tenant pool' option as the default for managers, SITE_TRANSFER_NEEDED shown as a transfer hint, do not clamp the deficit to 0.
